name: tinker-hanzi-converter
description: Chinese Character Tools Plugin for TINKER

tinker.name: Hanzi Converter
tinker.description: Chinese character tools for pinyin and conversion

zh-CN.name: 汉字转换
zh-CN.description: 汉字拼音、大写金额、简繁转换工具

to_pinyin.description: Convert Chinese text to pinyin. Updates the plugin UI and returns the pinyin result.

text.description: Chinese text to convert to pinyin

style.description: Pinyin style: tone marks (tone), tone numbers (toneNum), or plain (normal). Defaults to the plugin's current setting.

to_rmb.description: Convert a number to Chinese uppercase RMB amount (大写金额). Updates the plugin UI and returns the result.

convert_chinese.description: Convert between simplified and traditional Chinese. Updates the plugin UI and returns the converted text.

mode.description: Conversion direction. Defaults to the plugin's current setting.
